terms.label: acts on property
terms.definition: Relation between an Actuation and the property of a FeatureOfInterest it is acting upon.

terms.label: has feature of interest
terms.definition: A relation between an Observation and the entity whose quality was observed, or between an Actuation and the entity whose property was modified, or between an act of Sampling and the entity that was sampled.

terms.label: has result
terms.definition: Relation linking an Observation or Actuation or act of Sampling and a Result or Sample.

terms.label: has sample
terms.definition: Relation between a FeatureOfInterest and the Sample used to represent it.

terms.label: has simple result
terms.definition: The simple value of an Observation or Actuation or act of Sampling.

terms.label: hosts
terms.definition: Relation between a Platform and a Sensor, Actuator, Sampler, or Platform, hosted or mounted on it.

terms.label: is acted on by
terms.definition: Relation between an ActuatableProperty of a FeatureOfInterest and an Actuation changing its state.

terms.label: is feature of interest of
terms.definition: A relation between a FeatureOfInterest and an Observation about it, an Actuation acting on it, or an act of Sampling that sampled it.

terms.label: is hosted by
terms.definition: Relation between a Sensor, Actuator, Sampler, or Platform, and the Platform that it is mounted on or hosted by.

terms.label: is observed by
terms.definition: Relation between an ObservableProperty and the Sensor able to observe it.

terms.label: is result of
terms.definition: Relation linking a Result to the Observation or Actuation or act of Sampling that created or caused it.

terms.label: is sample of
terms.definition: Relation from a Sample to the FeatureOfInterest that it is intended to be representative of.

terms.label: made actuation
terms.definition: Relation between an Actuator and the Actuation it has made.

terms.label: made by actuator
terms.definition: Relation linking an Actuation to the Actuator that made that Actuation.

terms.label: made by sampler
terms.definition: Relation linking an act of Sampling to the Sampler (sampling device or entity) that made it.

terms.label: made by sensor
terms.definition: Relation between an Observation and the Sensor which made the Observation.

terms.label: made observation
terms.definition: Relation between a Sensor and an Observation made by the Sensor.

terms.label: made sampling
terms.definition: Relation between a Sampler (sampling device or entity) and the Sampling act it performed.

terms.label: observed property
terms.definition: Relation linking an Observation to the property that was observed. The ObservableProperty should be a property of the FeatureOfInterest (linked by hasFeatureOfInterest) of this Observation.

terms.label: observes
terms.definition: Relation between a Sensor and an ObservableProperty that it is capable of sensing.

terms.label: phenomenon time
terms.definition: The time that the Result of an Observation, Actuation or Sampling applies to the FeatureOfInterest. Not necessarily the same as the resultTime. May be an Interval or an Instant, or some other compound TemporalEntity.

terms.label: result time
terms.definition: The result time is the instant of time when the Observation, Actuation or Sampling activity was completed.

terms.label: used procedure
terms.definition: A relation to link to a re-usable Procedure used in making an Observation, an Actuation, or a Sample, typically through a Sensor, Actuator or Sampler.
